unitTitle: The Imperative - Reflexive Pronouns - Might/Could - Must/Have to - Can/Be allowed to - Could/Couldn't

pairsWith.noteUz: Can / be allowed to / could / had to mashqlari va 1-10-unitlar takrori (Revision).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 10-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET + REVISION 1-10 (53-bet, PDF 52). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '10'.

8) 'Use the prompts to make short dialogues, as in the example.' 1 ... I play loud music? (be quiet) SA: Can I play loud music? SB: No, you aren't allowed to play loud music. You have to be quiet. 2 ... we eat in the classroom? (eat in the cafeteria) 3 ... I ride my bike on the grass? (ride your bike somewhere else) 4 ... the dog come into the house? (stay outside) 5 ... I leave my luggage here? (leave it in the cloakroom) 6 ... we wear high-heeled shoes? (wear flat shoes) 7 ... I use this phone? (use public phone)
9) 'Mr Cropper spoke to his grandson about his life on a farm when he was young. Look at the table and prompts below and ask and answer questions, as in the example.' JADVAL (could / couldn't / had to / didn't have to): 1 wake up early to milk the cows - had to ✓; 2 play in the fields until very late at night - could ✓; 3 go horseback riding alone - couldn't ✓; 4 lock our doors - it was safe - didn't have to ✓; 5 swim in the lake - it was too cold - couldn't ✓; 6 get our water from a well - had to ✓; 7 buy eggs - we had our own hens - didn't have to ✓; 8 make bonfires in the summer - could ✓.

7 A: Can I use this phone? B: No, you aren't allowed to use this phone. You have to use the public phone.

exercises.instructionEn: Mr Cropper spoke to his grandson about his life on a farm when he was young. Look at the table and prompts below and ask and answer questions, as in the example. 1 wake up early to milk the cows (had to) 2 play in the fields until very late at night (could) 3 go horseback riding alone (couldn't) 4 lock our doors - it was safe (didn't have to) 5 swim in the lake - it was too cold (couldn't) 6 get our water from a well (had to) 7 buy eggs - we had our own hens (didn't have to) 8 make bonfires in the summer (could). Example: A: Did you have to wake up early to milk the cows? B: Yes, we did. We had to wake up early to milk the cows.
exercises.instructionUz: Kropper janob nabirasiga yoshligidagi fermadagi hayoti haqida gapirdi. Jadval va ko'rsatmalarga qarang va savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. 1 sigir sog'ish uchun erta turish (had to) 2 dalada kechgacha o'ynash (could) 3 yolg'iz otda yurish (couldn't) 4 eshiklarni qulflash - xavfsiz edi (didn't have to) 5 ko'lda suzish - juda sovuq edi (couldn't) 6 quduqdan suv olish (had to) 7 tuxum sotib olish - o'z tovuqlarimiz bor edi (didn't have to) 8 yozda gulxan yoqish (could). Namuna: A: Sigir sog'ish uchun erta turishga majbur edingizmi? B: Ha. Erta turishga majbur edik.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'TGAN ZAMON MODALLARI.

  had to → Did you have to ...?
    Yes, we did. We had to ...
  didn't have to → Did you have
    to ...? No, we didn't. We
    didn't have to ...
  could → Could you ...? Yes, we
    could. We could ...
  couldn't → Could you ...? No, we
    couldn't. We couldn't ...

exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Did you have to wake up early to milk the cows? B: Yes, we did. We had to wake up early to milk the cows.

modelAnswers: 1 A: Did you have to wake up early to milk the cows? B: Yes, we did. We had to wake up early to milk the cows.
2 A: Could you play in the fields until very late at night? B: Yes, we could. We could play in the fields until very late at night.
3 A: Could you go horseback riding alone? B: No, we couldn't. We couldn't go horseback riding alone.
4 A: Did you have to lock your doors? B: No, we didn't. We didn't have to lock our doors. It was safe.
5 A: Could you swim in the lake? B: No, we couldn't. We couldn't swim in the lake. It was too cold.
6 A: Did you have to get your water from a well? B: Yes, we did. We had to get our water from a well.
7 A: Did you have to buy eggs? B: No, we didn't. We didn't have to buy eggs. We had our own hens.
8 A: Could you make bonfires in the summer? B: Yes, we could. We could make bonfires in the summer.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Sigir sog'ish uchun erta turishga majbur edingizmi? - Ha, majbur edik. (NAMUNA)
2 Dalada kechgacha o'ynay olarmidingiz? - Ha, o'ynay olardik.

8 Yozda gulxan yoqa olarmidingiz? - Ha, yoqa olardik.

patterns.formula: Can I + FE'L? — No, you aren't allowed to + FE'L. You have to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I play loud music? — No, you aren't allowed to play loud music. You have to be quiet.
patterns.exampleUz: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q, ruxsat yo'q. Jim bo'lishingiz kerak.

patterns.formula: Did you have to + FE'L? — Yes, we did. / No, we didn't. We had to / didn't have to ...
patterns.exampleEn: Did you have to buy eggs? — No, we didn't. We didn't have to buy eggs.
patterns.exampleUz: Tuxum sotib olishga majbur edingizmi? — Yo'q, shart emas edi.

patterns.formula: Could you + FE'L? — Yes, we could. / No, we couldn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Could you swim in the lake? — No, we couldn't. It was too cold.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'lda suza olarmidingiz? — Yo'q. Juda sovuq edi.
